This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Mando9" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin that grew a darker red shade around their [[eye]]s. They also had two pairs of horns, one set extending from their cheek bones and one from their lower forehead, as well as multi-pronged pointed [[ear]]s.<ref name="Mando9" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]] when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Mando9" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ForeheadCheekSpikedSpecies-TAoTM.png|thumb|right|150px|Concept art by Brian Matyas.]]
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Jon Favreau]].<ref name="Mando9" /> This species' was conceptualized by [[Brian Matyas]], featuring much larger ears and more prominent forehead horns,<ref name="Art">[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season Two)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' (Season Two)]]</ref> while its in-episode design was finalized by [[Brian Sipe]] and team.<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=Brian-Sipe-Gamut-Studios-100031967872188|url=photo/?fbid=4944122138995819&set=a.179854822089265&rdid=KMnWzM6f7kq3tufU|name=[[Brian Sipe]]|date=2021-02-13|quote=Hey All of You d706’ers out there.
